calculation.description: At each date, reverse each asset's seven-day return relative to the cross-sectional median and scale by its trailing 20-day close-to-close volatility. Activate the signal only when lagged VIX is above its trailing 60-observation median; all inputs are lagged or trailing and therefore available at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Spearman cross-sectional IC on 15 tradable cross-asset instruments, retaining dates with at least 8 valid names. High-VIX regime activation share was 43.64%; subperiod IC/ICIR were 0.06728/0.18466 (2020-22), 0.01602/0.04652 (2023-24), and 0.02722/0.08470 (2025-26). Results are interpreted conservatively due to small cross-section.
